blocking_issues: CORE QUESTION NOT CONCLUSIVELY ANSWERED: whether the single, deduplicated GO#860 customer-entered value ('QA-DUAL-ARTWORK-TEST-860') is correctly applied to BOTH the Front artwork (4167/layer-558994) and the Back artwork (4172/layer-929347) print output could NOT be visually/pixel-level confirmed. This is NOT reported as MATCH (no positive visual confirmation exists) and is NOT a strict two-source CONFLICT per contract §8 (no two observations contradict each other) — it is an evidence gap: DO NOT treat the business rule as CONFIRMED_EXPECTED on the strength of this round alone. Recommend orchestrator route this to code-config-explorer or api-explorer to determine whether this is a known/intended limitation of this campaign's config, or a separate defect from the GO#860 share-value question.
